title: The Mirror-Wheel before the Gate of the King of Honor
description: A turning Wheel — the cosmic prochos — set immediately before the Great Gate of the King of Honor, holding the entire bound order of the firmaments transparent to the ruling Divine Truth. Twelve seals within, with the five Men of Radiance as the central seal filling the whole Zone. The cyclic process of purification carries a mirror-face: every concealed motion of bound proprium is reflected outward and made known.
